cards.meaning: to go bad, to be corrupt — in fiqh, of a prayer or fast: to be invalidated

cards.meaning: to introduce something new, to originate (literally, to bring forth) — in fiqh, to break one's wuḍūʾ

cards.extra: to introduce something new · Form IV · <bdi>مَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِي أَمْرِنَا هَذَا مَا لَيْسَ مِنْهُ فَهُوَ رَدٌّ</bdi> (Arbaʿīn 5) · same root as <bdi>الحَدَث</bdi>, ritual impurity
cards.source: Arbaʿīn, Ḥadīth 5 — vocab in the class notes, 2026-10-14

cards.meaning: conveying — making a message reach someone, or bringing someone to an aim

cards.meaning: rebuke — checking someone with a stern word or warning

cards.extra: to rebuke, to restrain · Form I · bāb <bdi>نَصَرَ يَنْصُرُ</bdi> · also, to drive off an animal with a shout — the root sense

cards.meaning: denial — rejecting what one knows to be true

cards.meaning: astute — sharp-witted about what truly benefits

cards.extra: astute · <bdi>الكَيِّسُ مَنْ دَانَ نَفْسَهُ وَعَمِلَ لِمَا بَعْدَ المَوْتِ</bdi>, the astute one holds himself to account and works for what comes after death (Tirmidhī)

cards.meaning: to hold to account, to subdue — also, to follow (a religion — <bdi>بِ</bdi>)

cards.extra: to hold to account, to subdue · Form I (hollow) · <bdi>دَانَ نَفْسَهُ</bdi>, he held himself to account · hence <bdi>يَوْمُ الدِّينِ</bdi>, the Day of Recompense

whim — what the soul leans toward, often against what is right

cards.meaning: to wish (for), to indulge in wishful hope

cards.extra: to wish · Form V (defective) · <bdi>تَمَنَّى عَلَى اللهِ</bdi>, he indulged in wishful hopes of Allah · <bdi>أُمْنِيَّة</bdi>, a wish (pl. <bdi>أَمَانِيّ</bdi>)

cards.meaning: discerning — one who looks into things with insight
an outcome — the end a thing leads to

cards.meaning: obedient — doing as one is commanded

cards.meaning: foolish, feeble-minded — in fiqh, one who squanders his wealth

cards.meaning: to concern, to matter to (someone) — also, to mean

cards.meaning: an expression, a wording — the words used to say something

cards.meaning: to be connected (with), to relate (to — <bdi>بِ</bdi>) — also, to cling to

cards.meaning: to be earnest, to strive hard (in — <bdi>فِي</bdi>)

cards.meaning: a waft, a breath (of fragrance) — figuratively, a gift of grace

cards.meaning: to move about, to go from place to place

cards.meaning: to stroll, to go on an outing — classically, to keep clear (of — <bdi>عَنْ</bdi>)

cards.extra: to stroll, to go on an outing · Form V · same root as <bdi>تَنْزِيه</bdi>, declaring Allah above every imperfection
